bootstrap.method: profile × round-wind stratified percentile bootstrap; each seed resamples all four seats and all ten policies together
bootstrap.rng: Mulberry32 with uint32 state wrapping on every draw
bootstrap.canonicalOrder: strata sorted by profile then roundWind, seed ascending within stratum
bootstrap.multiplicity: Five predeclared candidate-minus-own-baseline mean-net comparisons use 99% marginal percentile intervals (Bonferroni target 95% family coverage). All other 95% intervals, including D auxiliary metrics and subgroups, are exploratory.

metadata.highValueDefinition: Original single-yaku base points before kan fan increase and all fixed bonuses. Conditional shares use wins as denominator; unconditional rates use all games.
metadata.rankDefinition: Within-hand competition rank; tied first places count as topScore.

validation.individualActionAndTileInvariants: Checked by the runner engine; this aggregate analysis does not independently replay every action.

metadata.summedRowWallMsMeaning: Sum of playMilliseconds (legacy wallMs accepted) for recorded rows, possibly overlapping across workers; not total wall-clock duration.
